title: Serving Others
definition: Serving others is using one's strength, gifts, time, resources, and opportunities for the good of others in love.
summary: Christian service rejects selfishness and pride. It reflects the heart of Christ and builds up the Church, the vulnerable, the hurting, and the lost.
christFocus: Jesus came not to be served but to serve and give His life as a ransom for many.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Christian service rejects selfishness and pride. It reflects the heart of Christ and builds up the Church, the vulnerable, the hurting, and the lost.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
